description: List meta-transactions ("execute from outside") for a specific account contract. Cursor paginated: pass `cursor` from a previous response's nextCursor/prevCursor.

account.description: Account contract address whose meta-transactions to list (0x-prefixed).

cursor.description: Keyset cursor from a previous response's nextCursor/prevCursor. Omit for the first page.

network.description: Network to query. Defaults to the server's configured network (mainnet).

pageSize.description: Items per page: 10, 25, 50, or 100. Defaults to 25. Keep small to save context.

name: list_meta_transactions
